lastCompletedStory.title: Extend writeIssueFile CAS primitive to co-commit extra files

nextStoryContext: writeIssueFile (src/issues/alloc.ts) now accepts optional extraFiles?: FileWrite[] and commitMessage?: (id: string) => string, both fully backward compatible. US-002 (promoteSuggestionOnMain single atomic on-main commit) is the intended consumer: pass the rewritten scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl content as one entry in extraFiles, and use commitMessage to build 'chore(cam): suggestions promote <fp> -> <id>' from the freshly-allocated id. See the patterns.md bullet 'writeIssueFile now accepts extraFiles...' (US-001, CAM-290) for the exact call shape and re-hash-on-every-CAS-attempt guarantee.
